status: selected_specification; only NHC and hydrology audit processors implemented

cohorts.monitoring: predefined entities and calendar target times independent of future Y
cohorts.diagnostic: explicitly enriched events and controlled delivery conditions; no population calibration claim

initial_target_type: single_absolute_future_instant for the NHC/hydrology bridge only
natural_time_scale: hazard-specific minutes, hours, days or weeks; common protocol does not impose one forecast horizon
report_absence_policy: no report is not physical non-occurrence; score explicitly defined report/dataset endpoints separately
canonical_numeric_values: exact decimal strings; preserve raw values, units and flags
source_identity_rule: USGS official ID from NWPS crosswalk; no nearest-station substitution
observation_revision_rule: compare scientific value/unit/quality/support; row UUID or last_modified alone not semantic revision

outcome_quality.confirmed_default: pass source-specific final quality and outcome policy; USGS bridge requires Approved and no disqualifying qualifier
outcome_quality.window_negative: for any-exceedance targets only: all preregistered sample instants valid and below threshold
outcome_quality.other_window_targets: accumulation, sustained conditions and multiday events require their own complete-support rules; one exceedance is not enough

nhc_missing_numeric_forecast: keep fixed scheduled target with missing baseline; do not map dissipated/unmatched to zero
probability_baseline: official same-target probability or frozen training-only calibration/declared ensemble aggregation; point forecast not renamed probability
unmatched_professional_baseline: publish climatology/persistence/simple numeric comparisons; do not claim improvement over a professional forecast without a matched product
task_generation: fix monitoring cohort and dependency groups before deriving checkpoints, budgets, representations or delay branches

split_policy.dependence: group storms/basin_weather_processes/overlapping windows; shared global provider alone does not merge all events

release: preserve source terms, publish fetchers/manifests and permitted data; code license does not relabel source data
